chunks: Samaʿah ibn Mihrān asked him about the prayer during battle, so he said:
"When they meet and engage in fighting, then the salat at that time is only takbīr. And if they are standing and unable to perform in congregation, then the salat is by gestures."

key_terms.إِيمَاءٌ: performing the prayer through gestures when normal movements are not possible
key_terms.تَكْبِيرٌ: uttering 'Allāhu Akbar' as the form of prayer in intense combat
key_terms.صَلَاةِ: the ritual prayer being discussed in the context of battle

ai.seo_question: How is salat performed during active fighting in battle according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives the ruling for salat in conditions of active combat and extreme danger. It states that during direct fighting the prayer is reduced to takbir, and when congregation is not possible while standing in the battlefield, it is performed through gestures.
